newsitem.title: JAPAN: MHI wins test cell order from S'pore Airlines unit.
newsitem.headline: MHI wins test cell order from S'pore Airlines unit.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd (MHI) said on Wednesday it had received an order for a large test cell for jet engines from SIA Engineering Co, an aircraft maintenance company of Singapore Airlines Ltd.
The test cell would be able to test engines with a thrust of up to 150,000 pounds, a Mitsubishi Heavy spokesman said.

The spokesman did not give the value of the turnkey order, which excludes civil engineering work and supply of some of measurement equipment. But industry sources said it was estimated at about two billion yen.
